name: Deep In Hell
detailed_description:
Hell is an endless city of sins, where the population has become so accustomed to their pathetic existence that it has turned into a source of strange pleasure.

One fateful day, news comes of the death of God. God is dead, and what this news promises for the world is unknown. No respected investigator in hell wants to take on this dirty job, and it gets handed to the most degraded and aggressive detective. His office-elevator descends from level to level, passing through all nine levels of the city.

Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of uncertainty and drama, where every step could trigger a new truth or yet another betrayal. Will you uncover the mystery and restore justice, or will you become part of the endless cycle of sin and pain?

You will descend in an office-elevator to the very depths of the hellish city, filled with dangers and intrigues. Every decision matters. Encounter other characters — from power-hungry, mighty demons to voiceless and merciless monsters of the abyss — and untangle the complex web of lies and manipulations to uncover who is behind this horrific crime.

Key features of the game:

  • A gripping, brutal noir thriller with memorable characters, sharp dialogues, and a distinctive visual style.

  • Multiple unexpected endings that depend on player choices.

  • All characters are voiced by professional actors.

  • A card mini-game that allows you to gather new facts while interacting with suspects.
